lines.zh: 我贴着地面小跑，肚子很低。
lines.en: I trot low to the ground, belly close.

lines.zh: 身体长长一条，拐弯特别利落。
lines.en: Long body, and I turn sharply.

lines.zh: 我钻过倒木的缝隙，毫不费劲。
lines.en: I slip through the gap under a log with ease.

lines.zh: 雪地里，我换了一身白毛。
lines.en: In the snow my coat has turned white.

lines.zh: 我一路嗅一路走，鼻子不停。
lines.en: I walk with my nose working the whole way.

lines.zh: 我踮着脚走，脚步声很轻。
lines.en: I go on tiptoe, my steps very light.

lines.zh: 草丛一动，我就从里面穿过去。
lines.en: The grass stirs and I slip through it.

lines.zh: 我绕着石头走，懒得翻过去。
lines.en: I walk around the rock; too lazy to climb.

lines.zh: 我小跑几步，又停下来听。
lines.en: I trot a few paces, then stop to listen.
In snow I wear white.

lines.zh: 我沿着树根走，那里气味最多。
lines.en: I follow the roots where the smells are richest.

lines.zh: 我找个矮洞，一缩身就进去了。
lines.en: I find a low hole and squeeze straight in.
On open ground I'm not slow at all.

lines.zh: 我坐起来，两只前爪收着。
lines.en: I sit up, forepaws tucked.
Ears up, I turn them this way and that.
I lick a forepaw and wash my face.

lines.zh: 有只虫子爬过，我盯了很久。
lines.en: A bug crawls by; I watch it a long time.

lines.zh: 我把身子盘成一圈，暖和。
lines.en: I curl my body into a ring for warmth.

lines.zh: 我打了个哈欠，尖牙露出来。
lines.en: I yawn, and my little fangs show.

lines.zh: 我竖起上半身，四处张望。
lines.en: I rear up and look around.

lines.zh: 这气味是兔子的，还是蛋？
lines.en: Is that scent rabbit, or egg?
My tail taps softly on the ground.

lines.zh: 我趴着，眼睛却睁得很大。
lines.en: I lie down, but my eyes stay wide.

lines.zh: 这地方的味道我记熟了。
lines.en: I know the smells of this place by now.

lines.zh: 我抖了抖毛，把草屑甩掉。
lines.en: I shake my fur to shed the bits of grass.
My eyes are half shut, but I'm not asleep.

lines.zh: 我伸了个懒腰，身子拉得老长。
lines.en: I stretch and my body pulls out long.
I'm waiting for a sound.
An egg lands, and I dig.
I stand up and reach only your knee.

lines.zh: 兔子的味道，在你袖子上。
lines.en: Rabbit scent — on your sleeve.
I tilt my head and study you a while.
Hold still; I'll circle you once.
Crouch down, and let me sniff your hand.
In winter my coat turns white.
You smiled, so I relax a little.
I'm not afraid of people, only wary.

lines.zh: 你脚步声太重，老远就听见了。
lines.en: Your tread is heavy; I heard it far off.

lines.zh: 你弯下腰，我才看清你的脸。
lines.en: You bend down, and only then I see your face.

lines.zh: 你伸手指过来，我先闻一闻。
lines.en: You offer a finger; I sniff it first.

lines.zh: 这附近有没有洞，你知道吗？
lines.en: Know any burrows around here?
Don't grab my scruff; I dislike it.

lines.zh: 你蹲下来了，我就靠近点。
lines.en: You crouched, so I'll come closer.
My ears can turn to the back of my head.

lines.zh: 你袖口有熟兔肉的味道。
lines.en: Your cuff smells of cooked rabbit.

lines.zh: 我绕着你的靴子转了两圈。
lines.en: I circle your boots twice.

lines.zh: 你要是给吃的，我就跟你走。
lines.en: Offer food and I'll follow you.
Don't step on my tail.
Ouch! I curl into a ball.
Fur up, I bare my teeth at you.
I'm limping a little.
I'll remember that all day.
I back off and slip into the grass.

lines.zh: 雪地里的我会换成白毛。
lines.en: In snow, my coat turns white.
One squeak, and I shrink into the leaves.
I stop crying and hold it in.
It hurts enough that my teeth chatter.
Hit me again and I bite back.
Raw rabbit! You actually have some.

lines.zh: 那味道，我隔着草都闻到了。
lines.en: I smelled that through the grass.

lines.zh: 蛋给我，我就在你脚边挖。
lines.en: Give me the egg, and I'll dig at your feet.

lines.zh: 我往前凑了两步，又停下。
lines.en: I step forward twice, then stop.

lines.zh: 这味道让我尾巴都翘起来了。
lines.en: That smell lifts my tail right up.
Don't tease me; just set it down.
Sniffing it, I forget to be wary.
That meat would last me two days.
You drop an egg on the ground. I understand.

lines.zh: 我先挖两下，看看底下有什么。
lines.en: Let me dig twice and see what's underneath.

lines.zh: 土里要是有东西，我替你找。
lines.en: If there's something in the soil, I'll find it.
Something hard is buried in the gravel.

lines.zh: 我鼻子贴着地，一路刨过去。
lines.en: Nose to the ground, I dig my way along.

lines.zh: 你站在那儿别动，会踩到我的坑。
lines.en: Stand still or you'll step in my hole.
Drop another; I haven't dug enough.
I like this kind of trade.
Meat first, digging after.
Hey, watch your feet!

lines.zh: 撞得我翻了个跟头，没事。
lines.en: I tumble head over heels, but I'm fine.

lines.zh: 我的身子软，撞完就弹回来。
lines.en: I'm supple; I bounce right back.
Careful, I'm right by your shoe.
You messed up my fur.

lines.zh: 我钻到你腿间躲了一下。
lines.en: I dodge between your legs.
Back off a bit; I'm about to bolt.
That didn't hurt me.

lines.zh: 我咬了你裤脚，是下意识的。
lines.en: I bit your trouser leg on instinct.

lines.zh: 雪原换了白毛，你认不出我。
lines.en: In winter white, you won't recognize me.

lines.zh: 我在雪地里找伴，白毛更好认。
lines.en: I look for a mate in the snow; white coats are easier to spot.

lines.zh: 两只驯服的在一起，会有惊喜。
lines.en: Two tamed ones together may bring a surprise.

lines.zh: 你追我三步，我追你三步。
lines.en: You chase me three steps, I chase you three.

lines.zh: 我们钻同一根倒木下面。
lines.en: We both slip under the same fallen log.
Smell first; decide after.

lines.zh: 我尾巴摆得很快，你懂吧。
lines.en: My tail's wagging fast. You understand.
Not here. Too exposed.

lines.zh: 我这窝挖得不错，来看看。
lines.en: I dug a good burrow. Come see.
You don't bite me and I won't bite you.
This winter, company would be good.

lines.zh: 我从土里刨出一块东西。
lines.en: I dig something out of the soil.
An egg rolled into my hole.

lines.zh: 我叼起来，跑到一边慢慢看。
lines.en: I carry it off and look at it on my own.
Small. I'll carry it off in one mouthful.
What I dig up is mine.
I paw the dirt aside; there's more below.

lines.zh: 爪子扒了半天，总算拿到。
lines.en: Half a day of pawing and I finally have it.
I hide it under the fallen log.
This one's bigger than the last.
Tucked away. Don't let the birds see.
The grass moved. I'm on it.
That's not a bug. Too big.
I flatten down, belly against the fallen leaves.

lines.zh: 你站的位置，正好堵住洞。
lines.en: You're standing right in front of a burrow.
I'll keep my eyes on you and stay still.

lines.zh: 你的靴声太规律，好判断。
lines.en: Your bootfalls are too even; easy to read.

lines.zh: 我数着你走过来的步数。
lines.en: I count the steps as you approach.
Under the leaf litter, I've buried eggs.
I want what you're holding.
Right. I've fixed on you.
I circle around your feet.
When you lift a foot, I dart through.

lines.zh: 我的鼻子告诉我你的位置。
lines.en: My nose tells me where you are.

lines.zh: 我往草里退，只露一对耳朵。
lines.en: I back into the grass, only my ears showing.
One more step and I leap clear.

lines.zh: 我盯的是你的手，不是眼睛。
lines.en: I watch your hands, not your eyes.

lines.zh: 我试试从这边能不能钻过去。
lines.en: Let me see if I can slip through here.

lines.zh: 你转身的时候，我换个方向。
lines.en: When you turn, I change direction.
Crawling flat, I don't even cast a shadow.
At this distance one spring gets me there.
I lunge and bite your trouser leg.
Small sharp teeth, and I bite true.
One spring and I'm hanging at your waist.
I scratch once and pull back.
I'm not strong, but I'm fierce.
Bite, then run clear.
My teeth barely touch; consider it a warning.
Fur bristling, I try to scare you.
I bit through your shoelace.
Don't push me. My teeth are sharp.
I poke my head out of a snowdrift.

lines.zh: 林子边的土很松，正好挖洞。
lines.en: The soil at the wood's edge is soft, good for digging.
I land and shake out my fur.
This place smells of rabbit.
First I sniff the whole area.

lines.zh: 我在雪白的地方，毛也变白了。
lines.en: Where it's white with snow, my coat went white too.

lines.zh: 我从洞里钻出来，眼睛还没适应。
lines.en: I come out of the burrow, eyes still adjusting.

lines.zh: 平原上风大，我压低身子。
lines.en: The plains are windy; I keep low.
I wriggle out of the gravel pile.
First, a place to sleep.
Fire singes the tip of my tail.

lines.zh: 我摔下来，落地时滚了一圈。
lines.en: I fall and roll on landing.
I can't swim; all four legs flail.

lines.zh: 炸得我飞出去，落在草里。
lines.en: The blast throws me into the grass.

lines.zh: 一支箭射穿了我的耳朵边。
lines.en: An arrow tears past my ear.

lines.zh: 魔法让我毛发直立，动不了。
lines.en: Magic stands my fur on end and I can't move.
Hungry enough that my belly touches my spine.
In the snow, my fur turns white.

lines.zh: 虚空里，我的爪子抓不到东西。
lines.en: In the void my claws find nothing.
